verified: Electrek reported that BYD launched the third-generation Tang in China as a five-seat SUV with a starting price below $30,000 and two screens larger than 30 inches; the article lists a 402 hp (300 kW) rear motor and CLTC ranges of 730 km for the base Premium and 850 km for the Laser Premium and Laser Flagship. A separate ievchina listing also gives up to 850 km CLTC, a second-generation Blade Battery and God's Eye B ADAS.
unconfirmed: The exact Chinese price, delivery start, battery capacity and all-wheel-drive specifications are not disclosed; Electrek says "launched" while ievchina describes a Q4 launch following a Chengdu Auto Show unveiling, so whether customer deliveries have begun is unclear, and no independent range test or complete specification sheet is available.

verified: 据 Electrek 报道，比亚迪在中国推出第三代唐，定位五座旗舰纯电 SUV，起售价低于 3 万美元；同一篇报道列出的参数为后驱版单电机 402 马力（300 kW），CLTC 续航 730 公里（Premium 版）和 850 公里（Laser Premium、Laser Flagship 版）。行业媒体 ievchina 记录该车在 2026 年成都车展首发，搭载第二代刀片电池和“天神之眼”B 智驾系统。
unconfirmed: 具体起售价数字（报道只称“低于 3 万美元”）、各版本定价、交付时间以及中国以外市场的上市计划均未公布；730/850 公里为 CLTC 工况数据，并非独立实测，智驾功能的实际能力也没有第三方验证。

titles.en: BYD launches third-gen Tang EV, a five-seat SUV with dual 30-inch screens under $30,000
titles.zh: 比亚迪发布第三代唐 EV：五座旗舰 SUV 起售价低于 3 万美元
